faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 posts at BITS Pilani is 22-08-2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 post in the BITS Pilani recruitment drive. This is a great opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 posts at BITS Pilani is Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 at BITS Pilani?
faq.answer: The salary for Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 ranges from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 37,000 per month. JRF (NET/GATE) will receive Rs. 37,000 and Project Associate-I (Non-NET/GATE) will receive Rs. 30,000.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1?
faq.answer: Candidates should have an M.Sc/M.E/M.Tech or equivalent, or a B.E/B.Tech with significant research/industry experience, and must be GATE/NET qualified to be eligible for the post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 Recruitment 2026. The application process is free.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their merit, experience, and project requirements, followed by an online interview. Candidates will be informed about the interview schedule.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 position?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow/Project Associate-1 position is Pilani, Rajasthan. This offers an opportunity to work in a reputed institution in the state.

faq.answer: This is a Contractual job type. Candidates will be appointed for a specific period as per the project requirements. Details regarding the contract duration will be in the official notification.
